items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 4 at 8:29AM AKST until November 4 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Wind Advisory, southeast winds 20 to 25 mph with
gusts up to 40 mph. For the High Wind Watch, southeast winds 25 to
35 mph with gusts up to 60 mph possible.

* WHERE...Annette Island.

* WHEN...For the Wind Advisory, until 3 PM AKST this afternoon. For
the High Wind Watch, from Thursday morning through Thursday
evening.

* IMPACTS...High winds could blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel could be difficult. Tree

items.instruction:
People are urged to secure vessels and loose objects that could be
blown around or damaged by the wind.

Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: High Wind Watch issued November 4 at 8:29AM AKST until November 5 at 9:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
possible for areas with Southern to Southeastern exposures.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning through Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...High winds could blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong gusts will diminish in the evening
before increasing again Wednesday morning.
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure vessels and loose objects that could be
blown around or damaged by the wind.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 4 at 4:09AM AKST until November 6 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow expected. Total snow accumulations up
to two inches. Winds gusting between 35 to 50 mph.

* WHERE...Central Beaufort Sea Coast, Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast, and
Northern Arctic Coast.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile. Blizzard conditions will be
possible dependent on the severity of blowing snow.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will steadily increase today. Stron
items.areas: Northern Arctic Coast; Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 4 at 4:08AM AKST until November 4 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 45 mph with gusts up to 65 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
